title: ESP32-simple_reversable_counter: a reversible counter on the serial console
description: An ESP32 program that counts on the serial console and reverses direction when a key is pressed. Written in C with ESP-IDF and FreeRTOS, in VS Code with PlatformIO, at the Universidade de Brasília with Prof. Jones Yudi Mori Alves da Silva.

contributors.name: Mori Alves da Silva, Jones Yudi
